implementation.backend: apps/api/main.py: TracerProvider with ConsoleSpanExporter, TraceContextTextMapPropagator, and opentelemetry_tracing_middleware
implementation.frontend: apps/web/lib/api.ts: customFetch automated W3C traceparent header generation and correlation logger

after.span_exporter: OpenTelemetry ConsoleSpanExporter with structured JSON span lifecycle

production_readiness: In production, ConsoleSpanExporter can be swapped with OTLPSpanExporter (opentelemetry-exporter-otlp) pointing to Tempo / Jaeger / Datadog / Signoz by updating the SpanProcessor in main.py without changing application code.
